toggle_bulb.description: Turn a Wiz bulb ON or OFF.

change_color.description: Sets the color of the first discovered Wiz bulb using a HEX string.

set_brightness.description: Sets the brightness of the first discovered Wiz bulb.

temperature.description: Sets the color temperature of the first discovered Wiz bulb.

scenes.description: Sets a scene on Wiz bulb.

play_music.description: Plays audio files, optionally filtered by artist or album.

next_song.description: Skips to the next song in the current playlist.

toggle_music.description: Toggles between play and pause for the current music.

index_music.description: Indexes the music library to ensure all tracks are available for playback.

weather.description: Checks for rain within the next 7 days and provides the average daily temperature. Uses high-precision coordinates for the specified city or auto-detects location via IP if the city is omitted.

create_automation.description: Creates a new automation script file safely. The AI provides the full Python script as a string. Existing files with the same name are backed up automatically.

name.notes: Filename must contain only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and end with .py

script.notes: Full Python script as a string

create_playlist.description: Creates a new music playlist based on a topic using the local music index.

play_playlist.description: Plays the default local music playlist (playlist.json).
